name: Publish Python distribution to PyPI and TestPyPI

on: 
  workflow_dispatch:
  
  release:
    types:
      - created

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build distribution
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
      with:
        python-version: "3.x"
    - name: Install pypa/build
      run: >-
        python3 -m
        pip install
        build
        --user
    - name: Build a binary wheel and a source tarball
      run: python3 -m build
    - name: Store the distribution packages
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
      with:
        name: python-package-distributions
        path: dist/

  publish-to-pypi:
    name: >-
      Publish Python 🐍 distribution 📦 to PyPI
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')  # only publish to PyPI on tag pushes
    needs:
    - build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: pypi
      url: https://pypi.org/p/dynamax  # Replace <package-name> with your PyPI project name
    permissions:
      id-token: write  # IMPORTANT: mandatory for trusted publishing

    steps:
    - name: Download all the dists
      uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
      with:
        name: python-package-distributions
        path: dist/
    - name: Publish distribution 📦 to PyPI
      uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@dc37677b2e1c63e2034f94d8a5b11f265b73ba33 # v1.14.2

  publish-to-testpypi:
    name: Publish Python 🐍 distribution 📦 to TestPyPI
    needs:
    - build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    environment:
      name: testpypi
      url: https://test.pypi.org/p/dynamax

    permissions:
      id-token: write  # IMPORTANT: mandatory for trusted publishing

    steps:
    - name: Download all the dists
      uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
      with:
        name: python-package-distributions
        path: dist/
    - name: Publish distribution 📦 to TestPyPI
      uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@dc37677b2e1c63e2034f94d8a5b11f265b73ba33 # v1.14.2
      with:
        repository-url: https://test.pypi.org/legacy/

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
